name: Daryl the Youngling
summary: Daryl the Youngling is a human hunter residing at Farstrider Lodge in the southeastern hills of Loch Modan. Eager to prove his marksmanship among veteran dwarven trackers, he challenges traveling adventurers to hone their wilderness skills and test their mettle against the local beasts.

sections.title: A Human Among Mountaineers
sections.body: Farstrider Lodge is primarily a haven for dwarven mountaineers, trackers, and seasoned outdoorsmen who watch over the wilderness of Loch Modan. Daryl stands out as a young human striving to earn his place alongside these veteran stalkers. Rather than relying on mere bravado, he actively seeks to measure his hunting instincts against other travelers, issuing challenges to hunt down the tough wild boars and beasts roaming the crags and lakeshore.

faq.answer: Daryl is a young human hunter stationed at Farstrider Lodge in Loch Modan. Surrounded by grizzled dwarven marksmen, he tests newcomers with hunting contests to prove their skill with beasts and tracking.
Daryl stays at Farstrider Lodge, situated on the forested cliffs overlooking the southeastern shores of the lake in Loch Modan.

Compared to the experienced dwarven marksmen and lodge regulars who have spent decades patrolling Khaz Modan's rugged backcountry, Daryl is relatively young and untested, still working to establish a lasting reputation as a true hunter.

angles.text: Daryl speaks the language of tracking, beast behaviour, and the hunt, making his contests a natural proving ground for wandering hunters visiting Farstrider Lodge.
Finding a young human learning wilderness craft deep in dwarven territory highlights the practical camaraderie forged between Ironforge and the human kingdoms.
